chunks: And Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from some of our scholars from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubaid from Muhammad ibn Sinan who said:

Ali ibn Abi Hamza was mentioned before Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), so he cursed him, then said: 'Ali ibn Abi Hamza wanted that Allah should not be worshipped in His heavens and His earth, but Allah insisted on perfecting His light, even if the polytheists were displeased. And if the accursed polytheist were displeased.' I asked: 'The polytheist?' He replied: 'Yes, by Allah, and even if he grinds his nose [in disdain]. So it is, and it is in the Book of Allah: {They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths}, and it has been established regarding him and those like him that he wanted to extinguish the light of Allah.'
{They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths}
And it has been established regarding him and those like him that he wanted to extinguish the light of Allah.

key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), the eighth Imam
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ: Ali ibn Abi Hamza, a companion mentioned in Shia sources
key_terms.يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُطْفِئُوا نُورَ اللَّهِ: They want to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths (Quran 9:32)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ali ibn Abi Hamza and why did Imam al-Rida curse him?
ai.summary: In this report from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Rida (AS) identifies Ali ibn Abi Hamza as a *mushrik* (polytheist) for his claim that he could prevent Allah's worship, linking this arrogance to Surah At-Tawbah 9:32. The Imam explicitly connects the phrase 'those who try to extinguish Allah's light' to Ali ibn Abi Hamza, illustrating how his specific theological error of nullifying divine worship aligns with the Quranic description of the polytheists' futile efforts against God's light.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 75 - Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Yahya narrated from some of our scholars from Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubaid from Muhammad bin Sinan that he said:

Ali bin Abu Hamza was mentioned before Imam Ridha (a.s). Imam (a.s) cursed him and said: Ali bin Abi Hamza wants that Almighty Allah should not be worshipped in the heavens and the earth, but Almighty Allah wants to perfect the effulgence of His guidance, even if the accursed polytheists are displeased. I asked: Polytheists? He replied: Yes, by Allah, it is true and he will be degraded. This point is mentioned in the Book of Allah. Then he said: They wanted to blow out the effulgence of God.
This verse is about him and people like him who wished to put out the light of God.
